snippet.title: Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted - Official Developer Overview Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Check out the Developer Overview Trailer for Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted, an upcoming remaster of the original Plants vs. Zombies game developed by PopCap Games and The Lost Pixels. Players can hear from the development team on their approach to keeping the core fundamentals the same with modern features, the art direction, and more. Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming
